span.p:
One layer reads “The cat eats fish”
with several heads at the same time

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Head 1 — the grammar eye
cat → eats: who does it?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Head 2 — the object eye
eats → fish: what receives it?

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Head 3 — the time eye
verb tense: present, a habit

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Head 4 — the style eye
articles and modifiers: “the”, “a”…

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
the four reports are concatenated
and re-mixed by one learned projection

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
a much richer eats:
grammar + roles + time + style together
